threads.body: Lettuce reports these failures only as an error string on [5.1.0, 6.0.0), so the span becomes `ERROR` with no `error.type` under stable semconv. `LettuceDbAttributesGetter` doesn't override `getErrorType`, and `DbClientAttributesExtractor` falls back only to the exception class name, which is absent here. The `db.client.operation.duration` points for these failures also lose `error.type`. Overriding `getErrorType` to return the Redis error prefix from `response.getErrorMessage()`, such as `WRONGTYPE`, would set it.
